name: Fukuma
source:
Ready to give up writing, an author finds himself inside his final novel. With no memory of the ending and stuck as a side character, he must rediscover the story – and himself.

[From [url=https://fukuma.itch.io/fukuma]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
准备放弃写作的作家发现自己陷入了他的最后一部小说中。由于对结局没有记忆并被困在配角中，他必须重新发现这个故事——以及他自己。

[来自[url=https://fukuma.itch.io/fukuma]Itch.io[/url]]
